environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed as a container image on EKS Fargate (AWS Lambda Web Adapter pattern) within namespace 'prod-search'. Kubernetes NetworkPolicy 'restrict-metadata-egress' applied to the namespace with spec.podSelector matching label app=search-resolver, spec.policyTypes=['Egress'], spec.egress containing a single rule allowing TCP port 443 to CIDR 0.0.0.0/0 EXCEPT 169.254.169.254/32 (implemented via a Calico GlobalNetworkPolicy with a deny rule order 100 for destination 169.254.169.254/32 on all ports, combined with the namespace-scoped policy). Pod runs with service account 'search-sa' which has no IRSA annotation. The EKS node group has IMDSv2 enforced (HttpTokens=required, hop-limit=1) at the instance level, meaning even if network policy were bypassed, the container at hop 2 cannot reach IMDS.

config.platform: EKS Fargate with Lambda Web Adapter
config.network_policy: Calico GlobalNetworkPolicy order=100 denying egress to 169.254.169.254/32 all ports + namespace NetworkPolicy allowing only TCP/443 egress
config.service_account: search-sa (no IRSA, no IAM role annotation)
